note: Reverts the v566 scrolling change (document touch-action, panel wheel-scroll, and the #code start-aligned spacer). Typelines still use their own ntfy topic (data/cli.json). A parse or flesh-out error no longer drops the typed command: the raw line is still enqueued source=cli with parse_error, the status line shows the error, and if cli.json has not loaded the page retries that fetch then falls back to the drag endpoint. A typed-command error still cannot stop the runner.
